//: Root config for the test suite only. Each app keeps its own tsconfig; this one exists so `tsc --noEmit` can typecheck tests/ the way CI already typechecks all four apps. Its `paths` MIRROR the aliases in vitest.config.ts, so the typechecker resolves exactly what the runtime does: '@/*' can be any of the four app roots (the runtime picks by importer, which tsc cannot do, so it tries them in order), and next/link + next/navigation point at the same stubs the tests render against.
